entries.fingerprint: platform|tooling|dev instance status reports not ready when it runs on a real model
entries.title: dev_instance status reports not ready when it runs on a real model
entries.evidence: With HEPH_DEV_CHAT_* set the launcher never starts the stub (devkit/launch.py ensure_stub), but status_payload's `ready` is all(running.values()), which includes the stub port, so status --json says ready: false on a working instance.

entries.fingerprint: behavior|intercom|the worker roster line says a running worker cannot be corrected but agents message reaches it
entries.title: The worker roster line says a running worker can't be corrected, but agents_message reaches it
entries.evidence: services/agents/builtin.py worker description: "you cannot correct a worker while it runs"; tools/delegation.py agents_message: "It reaches a running agent at its next step". Talos is told both, and the intercom scenarios depend on the second.

entries.fingerprint: behavior|delegation|the delegation skill both says spawning a writer asks the operator and that spawning never asks

entries.evidence: skills/delegation/SKILL.md:18 "spawning one that can write asks the operator first" against :39 "Spawning and messaging never ask the operator".
